stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r: (i) 1/(4 − 3i) = p/(5q) + ri/(5q); (ii) (2 + i)/(2 − i) = (p + qi)/r; (iii) 1/(2 − i) = p/q + ir/5. (Value of p, q, r for each part.)
reason: Three-part question with separate answers. Also the printed key for (ii) says r = 3, but (2+i)/(2−i) = (3+4i)/5, so r = 5.
